question: From the top of a 195-m high cliff, the angles of depression of the top and bottom of a tower are 30∘ and 60∘, respectively. Find the height of the tower (in m).
solution:
**Given data:**

Angle of depression from cliff to the top of tower = 30º

Angle of depression from cliff to the bottom of tower = 60º

Height of cliff = 195 m

**Formula used:**

tan θ = p / b

Where “p” and “b” are perpendicular and base of a right-angled triangle.<o:p&g
